text.p: These are the leading stories in the morning newspaper in the Indian Ocean island of Mauritius on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Mauritius must import 36,000 tonnes of sugar to meet domestic demand and the government has already approved the purchase by the Mauritius Sugar Syndicate.

-- Opposition Mouvement Militant Mauricien (MMM) leader Paul Berenger and Mouvement Socialiste Militant (MSM) leader Anerood Jugnauth are setting up a joint strategy to put a stop to the Concession Projects Bill.
